## Load and wrangle data
#### Examined specimens
```{r, message = FALSE}
examined_specimens <- read_xlsx("data/bargmannia_dataset.xlsx", sheet = "examined")
```

#### Public distribution data

```{r, message = FALSE}
## load OBIS datasets
obis_data <- read_tsv("data/OBIS_occurence.csv")
## remove redundant columns
obis_data <- obis_data[,c(40, 2, 42, 43, 45, 197)]
obis_data <- obis_data %>% 
  mutate(scientificName = ifelse(scientificName=="Bargmannia", "Bargmannia sp.", scientificName),
         source = "OBIS")

## load GBIF data
gbif_data <- read_tsv("data/GBIF_occurence.csv")

## remove YPM data from GBIF to avoid duplicates - 29 records
gbif_data <- subset(gbif_data, institutionCode != "YPM") %>%
  mutate(species = replace_na(species, "Bargmannia sp."),
         source = "GBIF")

## subset irrelevant columns
gbif_data <- gbif_data[,c(33, 1, 22, 23, 28, 10, 51)]

## load published data
published_data <- read_xlsx("data/bargmannia_dataset.xlsx", sheet = "published")
published_data <- published_data[,c(4,2,7,8,6,1,9)]

## load unpublished data from MBARI
mbari <- read_tsv("data/Bargmannia_subfields.tsv")
mbari <- mbari %>%
  mutate(species = ifelse(Concept=="Bargmannia", "Bargmannia sp.", 
                        ifelse(Concept == "Bargmannia amoena", "Bargmannia pyrosa", Concept)),
         source = "mbari")
mbari[c('year', 'RecordedDate-year')] <- str_split_fixed(mbari$RecordedDate, '-', 2)
mbari <- mbari[,c(9, 6, 3, 4, 2, 7, 8)]

## bin vertical data every 40 m
mbari_subset <- mbari %>% 
  mutate(Depth_rd = (floor(Depth / 40) * 40),
         Latitude = round(Latitude,4), 
         Longitude = round(Longitude,4)) %>% 
  group_by(year, DiveStr, species, Depth_rd, Latitude, Longitude, source) %>% 
  tally()

mbari_subset <- mbari_subset[,c(1,2,5,6,4,3,7)]

## rename columns to match across data frames
names(gbif_data)[names(gbif_data) == 'gbifID'] <- 'id'
names(gbif_data)[names(gbif_data) == 'decimalLatitude'] <- 'Latitude'
names(gbif_data)[names(gbif_data) == 'decimalLongitude'] <- 'Longitude'

names(obis_data)[names(obis_data) == 'scientificName'] <- 'species'
names(obis_data)[names(obis_data) == 'date_year'] <- 'year'
names(obis_data)[names(obis_data) == 'decimalLatitude'] <- 'Latitude'
names(obis_data)[names(obis_data) == 'decimalLongitude'] <- 'Longitude'

names(published_data)[names(published_data) == 'Year'] <- 'year'
names(published_data)[names(published_data) == 'SampleID'] <- 'id'
names(published_data)[names(published_data) == 'Depth'] <- 'depth'
names(published_data)[names(published_data) == 'Taxon'] <- 'species'
names(published_data)[names(published_data) == 'Source'] <- 'source'

names(mbari_subset)[names(mbari_subset) == 'Depth_rd'] <- 'depth'
names(mbari_subset)[names(mbari_subset) == 'DiveStr'] <- 'id'

# merge documents
public_data <- rbind(obis_data, gbif_data, published_data, mbari_subset)
public_data <- public_data[complete.cases(public_data[,3:4]),]
names(public_data)[names(public_data) == 'species'] <- 'Taxon'

# add source ID
public_data <- public_data %>%
  mutate(source = "public data")

# remove records with erroneous coordinates (falling on land)
vector_rm1 <- public_data %>% 
  filter(Longitude >= 29.2518 & Longitude <= 29.26)
vector_rm2 <- public_data %>%
  filter(Latitude >= 27 & Longitude >=0 & Longitude <= 8)
vector_rm <- rbind(vector_rm1, vector_rm2)

public_data <- public_data %>%
  subset(!id %in% vector_rm$id)
```

#### Depth summary
This chunk generates a single data frame for subsequent vertical distribution analysis

```{r}
# subset only relevant columns
examined_specimens[c('year', 'Date-year')] <- str_split_fixed(examined_specimens$Date, '-', 2)

# create new df with columns matching public_data
examined_distribution <- examined_specimens[,c(16, 3, 10, 11, 5, 2)]
examined_distribution <- examined_distribution %>%
  mutate(source = "this_study")

# rename columns to match
names(examined_distribution)[names(examined_distribution) == 'SampleID'] <- 'id'
names(examined_distribution)[names(examined_distribution) == 'Depth'] <- 'depth'

# merge all data
distribution_all <- rbind(examined_distribution, public_data)

# check for duplicates, merge within 20 m bins, remove NAs, add count and modify source label, retaining this study in cases where same specimen was reported elsewhere
distribution_verified <- distribution_all %>% 
  mutate(Latitude = round(Latitude, 3), 
         Longitude = round(Longitude, 3),
         depth = (floor(depth / 20) * 20)) %>% 
  group_by(year, Taxon, Latitude, Longitude, depth) %>%  
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    source = paste(unique(source), collapse = "; ")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(complete.cases(Latitude, Longitude, depth)) %>%
  mutate(Counts = 1,
         source = ifelse(grepl("this_study", source), "this_study", source))

```

## Horizontal distribution
#### plotting maps in Roinson projection
```{r}
LeftBound = -90
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf") %>% 
  st_set_crs(4326)
robinson <- paste("+proj=robin +lon_0=", LeftBound, " +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs", sep="")

world2 <- world %>% 
  st_break_antimeridian(lon_0 = LeftBound) %>% 
  st_transform(crs = robinson)

# bin same records
public_bin <- public_data %>% 
  mutate(Latitude = round(Latitude,3), 
         Longitude = round(Longitude,3)) %>% 
  group_by(Latitude,Longitude, Taxon) %>% tally()

# Convert data to sf object and transform projection
public_bin_sf <- st_as_sf(public_bin, 
                           coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = robinson)

examined_specimens_sf <- st_as_sf(filter(examined_specimens, !is.na(Latitude)), 
                                  coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = robinson)


# Set orders of factor variables
examined_specimens_sf$Taxon <- factor(examined_specimens_sf$Taxon, levels = c("Bargmannia amoena", "Bargmannia elongata", "Bargmannia gigas", "Bargmannia lata", "Bargmannia marlena", "Bargmannia profunda", "Bargmannia pyrosa", "Bargmannia stenotes", "Bargmannia sp."))
public_bin_sf$Taxon <- factor(public_bin_sf$Taxon, levels = c("Bargmannia amoena", "Bargmannia elongata", "Bargmannia gigas", "Bargmannia lata", "Bargmannia marlena", "Bargmannia profunda", "Bargmannia pyrosa", "Bargmannia stenotes", "Bargmannia sp."))

# count specimens per species across two datasets
this_study_counts <- distribution_verified %>% 
  filter(source == "this_study") %>%
  group_by(Taxon) %>% 
  summarise(count = n())
public_counts <- distribution_verified %>% 
  filter(source != "this_study") %>%
  group_by(Taxon) %>% 
  summarise(count = n())

# create df with both counts for plotting
label_data <- full_join(
  public_counts %>% rename(public_count = count),
  this_study_counts %>% rename(this_count = count),
  by = "Taxon") %>%
  mutate(
    public_count = replace_na(public_count, 0),
    this_count   = replace_na(this_count, 0),
    label = paste0(
      "N this study = ", this_count, "\n",
      "N public data = ", public_count))

label_data$Taxon <- factor(label_data$Taxon, levels = c("Bargmannia amoena", "Bargmannia elongata", "Bargmannia gigas", "Bargmannia lata", "Bargmannia marlena", "Bargmannia profunda", "Bargmannia pyrosa", "Bargmannia stenotes", "Bargmannia sp."))

# create map figure  
glob.map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world2, fill = "light gray", colour = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = public_bin_sf, aes(color = "#000000"), size = 1.1, shape = 16, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_sf(data = examined_specimens_sf, aes(fill = Taxon), size = 1.2, shape = 21, stroke = 0.2, alpha = 0.9) +
  #geom_sf(data = examined_specimens_sf, aes(color = Taxon), size = 1.1, shape = 16, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text(data = label_data, aes(x = -Inf, y = -Inf, label = label),
            hjust = 0, vjust = -0.5, size = 1.5, lineheight = 0.9, inherit.aes = TRUE)+ 
  scale_fill_manual(values = sp.palette.fullname2)+
  scale_color_manual(values = sp.palette.fullname2)+
    th+
  theme(panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=6, colour ="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=6, colour ="black"),
        legend.title = element_text(size=5, face = "bold", colour ="black"),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.15, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size=5, colour ="black"),
        legend.position= "none",
        strip.background = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = "white", linewidth = 0.5),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 6, vjust = 0, face = "italic"),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines"),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank())+
  guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=2,byrow=TRUE))+
  facet_wrap(~Taxon)

ggsave(filename = "results/Fig_distribution.pdf", plot = glob.map, device = "pdf", dpi = 600,
       width = 18, height = 11, units = "cm")
```

## Vertical distribution
```{r}
# filter out unidentified Bargmannia and Bargmannia gigas
filtered_distribution <- distribution_verified %>% 
  filter(Taxon != "Bargmannia sp." & Taxon != "Bargmannia gigas")

# Split data into two subsets
public_data <- filtered_distribution %>% 
  filter(source == "public data")
study_data  <- filtered_distribution %>% 
  filter(source == "this_study")

# recalculate counts on filtered distribution data
this_study_counts_2 <- filtered_distribution %>% 
  filter(source == "this_study") %>%
  group_by(Taxon) %>% 
  summarise(count = n())
public_counts_2 <- filtered_distribution %>% 
  filter(source != "this_study") %>%
  group_by(Taxon) %>% 
  summarise(count = n())

# factorize source variable to force the order
filtered_distribution$source <- factor(filtered_distribution$source, levels = c("this_study", "public data"))

# plot vertical ridges data
vertical.ridges <- ggplot(data = filter(filtered_distribution, Taxon != "Bargmannia sp."), 
                           aes(x=source, y=depth))+
  stat_halfeye(data = filter(filtered_distribution, source == "this_study"), 
               aes(color=Taxon, fill=Taxon), 
               adjust = 1, justification = -0, .width = 0, point_colour = NA) +
  stat_halfeye(data = filter(filtered_distribution, source != "this_study"), 
               adjust = 1, justification = -0, .width = 0, point_colour = NA, 
               color="grey", fill="grey", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_swarm(data = filter(filtered_distribution, source == "this_study"), 
             aes(color=Taxon, fill=Taxon), 
             dotsize = 0.08, 
             position = position_nudge(x = -0.24), 
             side = "left", width = 0.3)+
  geom_swarm(data = filter(filtered_distribution, source != "this_study"),  
             aes(color="grey", alpha = 0.3), 
             dotsize = 0.08, 
             position = position_nudge(x = -0.24), 
             side = "left", width = 0.3)+
  geom_boxplot(data = filter(filtered_distribution, source == "this_study"),
               width = 0.3, color = "black",
               lwd = 0.3,
               outlier.color = NA, alpha = 0.3, fill = NA) + 
  geom_boxplot(data = filter(filtered_distribution, source != "this_study"), 
               width = 0.3, color = "black", 
               lwd = 0.3,
               outlier.color = NA, alpha = 0.3, fill = NA)+
  geom_text(data = this_study_counts_2, 
            aes(x = "this_study", y = 6000, label = paste0("bold('", count, "')"), color = Taxon), 
            parse = TRUE,
            size = 2) + 
  geom_text(data = public_counts_2, 
            aes(x = "public data", y = 6000, label = paste0("bold('", count, "')"), color = "#000000"),
            parse = TRUE,
            size = 2) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values=sp.palette.fullname2)+
  scale_color_manual(values=sp.palette.fullname2)+
  scale_y_reverse()+
  ylab("Depth [m]")+
  xlab("Data source")+
  th+ 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, colour ="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, colour ="black"),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black', linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.ticks = element_line(colour = 'black'),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 6, face = "italic"),
        strip.background = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = "white", linewidth = 0.5),
        legend.position="none")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "this_study" = "this\nstudy",
    "public data" = "public\ndata"))+
  facet_grid(~Taxon, labeller = label_wrap_gen(width=10))

vertical.ridges

ggsave(filename = "results/Fig_vertical.pdf", plot = vertical.ridges, device = "pdf",
       width = 18, height = 7.29, units = "cm")
```

## Testing differences in vertical distribution
```{r}
# test data distribution
shapiro_results_vert <- examined_specimens %>%
  filter(Taxon != "Bargmannia sp." & Taxon != "Bargmannia gigas") %>%
  group_by(Taxon) %>%
  summarise(p_value = shapiro.test(Depth)$p.value) %>%
  mutate(p_value = round(p_value, 3))

write.csv(shapiro_results_vert, "results/shapiro_results_vertical.csv")

# run Kruskal-Wallis test with Dunn post-hoc between cell types
KW_vert <- examined_specimens %>%
  filter(Taxon != "Bargmannia sp." & Taxon != "Bargmannia gigas") %>%
  kruskal_test(Depth ~ Taxon)%>%
  mutate(p = round(p, 3))

write.csv(KW_vert, "results/KW_vertical.csv")

dunn_test_vert <- examined_specimens %>%
  filter(Taxon != "Bargmannia sp." & Taxon != "Bargmannia gigas") %>%
  dunn_test(Depth ~ Taxon, p.adjust.method = "holm") %>%
    select(group1, group2, statistic, p.adj) %>%
  mutate(
    statistic = round(statistic, 3),
    p.adj = round(p.adj, 3)
  ) %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
  rename('Species 1' = group1,
         'Species 2' = group2,
         'Z statistic' = statistic,
         'Adjusted p-value' = p.adj)

write.csv(dunn_test_vert, "results/dunn_test_vertical.csv")
```

## Environment
```{r}
# test data distribution
examined_specimens_piv <- pivot_longer(examined_specimens, c(6:9), names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Value")

# run Shapiro-Wilk test for normality
shapiro_results_env <- examined_specimens_piv %>%
  group_by(Taxon, Parameter) %>%
  filter(Taxon != "Bargmannia gigas" & 
           Taxon != "Bargmannia sp." & 
           Taxon != "Bargmannia amoena" &
           Parameter != "Transmiss") %>% 
  summarise(p_value = shapiro.test(Value)$p.value)

write.csv(shapiro_results_env, "results/shapiro_results_env.csv")

# run Kruskal-Wallis test with Dunn post-hoc between cell types
stat.test_env <- examined_specimens_piv %>%
  group_by(Parameter) %>%
    filter(Taxon != "Bargmannia gigas" & 
           Taxon != "Bargmannia sp." & 
           Taxon != "Bargmannia amoena" &
           Parameter != "Transmiss") %>%
  kruskal_test(Value ~ Taxon)

write.csv(stat.test_env, "results/KWtest_env.csv")

dunn.test_env <- examined_specimens_piv %>%
  group_by(Parameter) %>%
  filter(Taxon != "Bargmannia gigas" & 
           Taxon != "Bargmannia sp." & 
           Taxon != "Bargmannia amoena" &
           Parameter != "Transmiss") %>%
  dunn_test(Value ~ Taxon, p.adjust.method = "holm") %>%
    select(Parameter, group1, group2, statistic, p.adj) %>%
  mutate(
    statistic = round(statistic, 3),
    p.adj = round(p.adj, 3)
  ) %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
  rename('Species 1' = group1,
         'Species 2' = group2,
         'Z statistic' = statistic,
         'Adjusted p-value' = p.adj)
write.csv(dunn.test_env, "results/dunn_test_env.csv")

# generate plot
env.species <- ggplot(filter(examined_specimens_piv, 
                             Taxon != "Bargmannia gigas" & 
                               Taxon != "Bargmannia sp." & 
                               Taxon != "Bargmannia amoena" &
                               Parameter != "Transmiss"), 
                      aes(y=Taxon, x=Value, fill = Taxon))+
  stat_boxplot(geom ='errorbar', width = 0.4, color = "black")+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.color = NA, color="black", outlier.size = NA, alpha = .2)+
  geom_jitter(size = 2, aes(color = Taxon), alpha = .8, width = 0.3)+
  scale_color_manual(values=sp.palette.fullname2)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=sp.palette.fullname2)+
  coord_flip()+
  scale_x_reverse()+
  th+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face = "italic", vjust = 0.6, angle = 45),
        axis.title.y = element_blank())+
  facet_wrap(~Parameter, scales = "free")+
  ylab("Species")+
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c(
    "Bargmannia amoena" = "B. amoena",
    "Bargmannia elongata" = "B. elongata",
    "Bargmannia lata" = "B. lata",
    "Bargmannia marlena" = "B. marlena",
    "Bargmannia profunda" = "B. profunda",
    "Bargmannia pyrosa" = "B. pyrosa",
    "Bargmannia stenotes" = "B. stenotes"))

ggsave(filename = "results/Fig_env_preferences.pdf", plot = env.species, device = "pdf", dpi = 600,
       width = 18, height = 9, units = "cm")
```
